verdicts.reason: Identified two bugs in the change: (1) dropping the size equality check before setPopoverMaxSize in useComboboxFloat.ts causes unconditional re-renders on measurement cycles due to new object reference creation, and (2) removing await from user.click(input) in MultiCombobox.test.tsx leaves an unhandled Promise racing with test assertions.

findings.message: user.click(input) is an asynchronous operation returning a Promise, but await was removed. Leaving the promise unawaited causes the click event dispatch to race against subsequent assertions and can trigger unhandled act() warnings or flaky test failures.

The guard comparing calculated dimensions against the previous size was dropped before calling setPopoverMaxSize. Because a new { width, height } object is passed to setPopoverMaxSize on every measurement inside size().apply, React triggers a re-render even when measurements are unchanged, causing redundant re-renders or infinite update loops.
Assertions were removed or rewritten; equivalent replacement coverage has not been established.
A test file was removed. Confirm replacement coverage.

verdicts.reason: The change removes aggregated discovery negotiation from discoverGroups. This breaks an invariant visible in aggregateBackend for baas_apiserver targets, where CRD-backed groups are only exposed via aggregated discovery and will no longer be discovered.

findings.message: Removing the Accept header requesting aggregated discovery breaks discovery for baas_apiserver aggregate targets. The plain /apis response on standalone apiextensions apiservers only returns apiextensions.k8s.io and omits CRD-backed groups, which are only served in the aggregated discovery format. Without requesting this format, discoverGroups silently fails to discover CRD groups on baas_apiserver.
findings.evidence:
-	req.Header.Set("Accept", aggregatedDiscoveryJSON+", application/json")
 	resp, err := client.Do(req)

verdicts.reason: The change reverts aggregated discovery support in pkg/router/aggregate_discovery.go and deletes its pinning unit test in pkg/router/aggregate_discovery_test.go. This is a violation of note aggregate-apiserver-introspection-requires-aggregated-discov, which documents that standalone aggregate apiextensions apiservers require the apidiscovery.k8s.io Accept header to expose dynamic CRD groups under /apis. The remaining notes in the cache are unrelated to the router package.

findings.message: discoverGroups removes the aggregated discovery Accept header and the decoding of APIGroupDiscoveryList via decodeDiscoveryResponse, decoding responses solely into metav1.APIGroupList. This violates the invariant that aggregate apiserver introspection requires aggregated discovery format for dynamic CRD groups, causing targets like baas_apiserver to omit dynamic CRDs from /apis. The regression test TestDiscoverGroups_AggregatedFormat was also deleted.
findings.evidence:
-	req.Header.Set("Accept", aggregatedDiscoveryJSON+", application/json")
 	resp, err := client.Do(req)
